title: "02b · Quantification at a fixed DPC slope"

The fitted slope sits below the 0.7 to 0.9 band limpa's FAQ calls typical for DIA-NN searched with
match-between-runs. This refits quantification with the slope held at 0.7 and compares what comes
out. Separate from `02_quantify.qmd` so it keeps its own cache and cannot invalidate the main run.

```{r setup}
library(here)
library(limpa)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)

y <- readRDS(here("01_Preprocess", "01_Filtering", "c_data", "precursors_filtered.rds"))
proteins_fitted <- readRDS(here("01_Preprocess", "02_Quantification", "c_data", "proteins.rds"))
d <- readRDS(here("02_Differential_Expression", "01_Design", "c_data", "design.rds"))
```

```{r quantify}
#| cache: true
proteins_07 <- dpcQuant(y, "Protein.Group", dpc.slope = 0.7)
proteins_07 <- proteins_07[filterByDetection(
  proteins_07, n.samples = min(table(proteins_07$targets$group))
), ]
```

```{r compare-matrix}
tibble(
  slope = c("fitted", "0.7"),
  proteins = c(nrow(proteins_fitted), nrow(proteins_07)),
  mean_se = c(mean(proteins_fitted$other$standard.error),
              mean(proteins_07$other$standard.error))
)
```

```{r compare-contrasts}
fit_07 <- proteins_07 |>
  dpcDE(d$design, sample.weights = TRUE, plot = FALSE) |>
  contrasts.fit(d$contrasts) |>
  eBayes(robust = TRUE)

map(colnames(d$contrasts), \(cn) {
  tibble(contrast = cn,
         n_fdr_05 = sum(topTable(fit_07, coef = cn, number = Inf)$adj.P.Val < 0.05))
}) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  left_join(read_csv(here("02_Differential_Expression", "02_Differential", "c_data",
                          "contrast_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
              select(contrast, fitted_slope = n_fdr_05),
            by = "contrast")
```
